qualification: Files were observed in provider directory listings at the stated metadata check times. Only identified representative payloads were downloaded and inspected. This snapshot is not a live availability test and does not establish valid data at the project geometry.

chirps_v2_daily.format: NetCDF; daily precipitation values in monthly files
chirps_v2_daily.spatialDelivery: Whole provider grid: all longitudes, 50°S–50°N. Land mask and missing cells remain as supplied.
chirps_v2_daily.temporalDelivery: One complete calendar-month file containing daily fields. No date slicing is performed by this tool.

listingChecks.browserCors: No Access-Control-Allow-Origin header observed; browser listing fetch is not supported.

notes: CHIRPS v2 daily values disaggregate pentad totals using CFSv2; they are not independent daily gauge observations.
The producer plans to end v2 production after December 2026. Preserve the original catalog caveats and consider the separately identified v3 products.

chirps_v3_daily_rnl.format: NetCDF4 monthly files containing daily CHIRPS v3 final rnl fields
chirps_v3_daily_rnl.spatialDelivery: Whole provider grid: all longitudes, 60°S–60°N. Land mask and missing cells remain as supplied.
chirps_v3_daily_rnl.temporalDelivery: Whole calendar-month files of daily fields; no date slicing, spatial clipping or averaging.

listingChecks.browserCors: No Access-Control-Allow-Origin header observed; browser listing fetch is not supported.

notes: Final rnl daily values use ERA5 to partition CHIRPS v3 pentad amounts. Agreement with that disaggregation source is not independent validation.
Daily dates are UTC calendar-day labels, not uniform observing windows across contributing gauges. No local temporal conversion is performed.
rnl and sat files can have identical basenames. Preserve product ID and full provider URL to avoid mixing variants.

chirps_v3_daily_sat.format: NetCDF4 monthly files containing daily CHIRPS v3 final sat fields
chirps_v3_daily_sat.spatialDelivery: Whole provider grid: all longitudes, 60°S–60°N. Land mask and missing cells remain as supplied.
chirps_v3_daily_sat.temporalDelivery: Whole calendar-month files of daily fields; no date slicing, spatial clipping or averaging.

listingChecks.browserCors: No Access-Control-Allow-Origin header observed; browser listing fetch is not supported.

notes: Final sat daily values use IMERG Late V07 to partition CHIRPS v3 pentad amounts. Agreement with that disaggregation source is not independent validation.
Daily dates are UTC calendar-day labels, not uniform observing windows across contributing gauges. No local temporal conversion is performed.
rnl and sat files can have identical basenames. Preserve product ID and full provider URL to avoid mixing variants.

This inspected monthly-NetCDF route begins in June 2000. The current producer README says daily sat begins in 1998, while older documentation says 2001; these conflicting scopes remain explicit. Earlier dates are not indexed here and may use another packaging route. No monthly filename is invented for them.

gpcc_monthly_v2025.format: gzip-compressed NetCDF; monthly totals and diagnostics
gpcc_monthly_v2025.spatialDelivery: Whole global provider grid (90°S–90°N, all longitudes); precipitation is land based and missing/ocean cells remain as supplied.
gpcc_monthly_v2025.temporalDelivery: Five-year files through 2020, one 2021–2024 file, then individual monthly files from 2025. All monthly fields in a selected file are downloaded.
